title: Brakeman And Rails Security: Mike Hall Interviews Justin Collins | RailsConf 2014

dimensions.historical_context_at_recording: RailsConf 2014 Chicago (Rails 4.1), GOTO Chicago 2014, Continuous Delivery boom with Jez Humble, Brakeman security adoption.
dimensions.subsequent_history_and_trajectory: Brakeman became the mandatory static security analysis standard integrated into Rails CI/CD pipelines worldwide.
